overview: The Medford School Committee met to receive reports on administrator professional development, student financial literacy, and the FY23 operating budget. The committee also passed several policy updates and procedural resolutions regarding committee meetings and superintendent evaluation timelines.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent shared district news and student accomplishments, announced upcoming graduation and award events, and led a moment of silence for victims of the Buffalo mass shooting.

items.title: Professional Development Presentation for Administrators
items.summary: Harvard doctoral resident Dr. Carmen Williams presented her findings and recommendations on administrative professional development and collaborative data-driven practice in the district.

items.title: Report on Credit for Life Event
items.summary: Dr. Bernadette Ricciardelli and Lisa Evangelista presented a report on the May 6 Credit for Life financial literacy event for high school seniors.

items.title: FY23 Operating Budget Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy reviewed fixed cost projections, ESSER grant strategy, and potential local budget impacts for universal free school meals.

items.title: Policy BDG: Committee Attorney
items.summary: The committee approved updated policy language regarding committee legal services.

items.title: Public Comment Residency Requirement Exemption for Employees
items.summary: The committee approved a policy addition allowing non-resident district employees to participate in public comment.

items.title: Policy Manual Alignment with Rules of Order
items.summary: The committee approved updates aligning committee policy language with recently adopted rules of order.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation Timeline
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution establishing key meeting dates and evaluation procedures for the superintendent's performance review.

items.title: Scheduling Additional Regular Meeting
items.summary: The committee voted to schedule an additional regular meeting on June 13, 2022.

items.title: Superintendent Goals Timeline
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution outlining the process for discussing and finalizing superintendent goals for the 2022–2023 school year by September 30, 2022.

items.title: Referral of Attendance and Truancy Policies
items.summary: The committee referred district attendance and truancy policies to the Communication and Family Engagement Subcommittee for review.

items.title: Referral of Wellness Policy Regarding Recess
items.summary: The committee referred the K–8 wellness policy to the Rules and Policy Subcommittee to address unstructured daily free play recess and reporting on recess curtailment.

items.title: Report Request: NWEA MAP Implementation
items.summary: The item regarding NWEA MAP implementation was noted as pending.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the family of former lunch mother Virginia F. O'Neill.
